exhibits.title: The five questions and our answers
exhibits.subtitle: Foreign charging operator entering Indonesia · evidence to early October 2026 · confidence = our judgement of the evidence
exhibits.source: Source: chapter pages; [Kira estimates] where marked
rows: A wholly owned operator (open to 100% foreign ownership) on landlord and fleet contracts, using PLN's bulk tariff; the PLN franchise is cheaper but leaves price and customer with PLN; equipment supply suits hardware makers only [Emerhub 2026]

Taxi and ride-hailing fleets for repeat sessions; mall and toll-road landlords for sites; PLN for power and app listing; carmakers bring drivers but want their own networks [Kontan JMRB Dec 2025]; [Electrive Aug 2024]
Greater Jakarta (30% of public units, 803,000 sessions in 2025), then the toll road to Bandung, then Surabaya and Bali in year two [ESDM Feb 2026]; [Bisnis Apr 2026]
4 · What year one costs, and where it breaks
About Rp 37 bn (USD 2.1 m) for 20 sites with 30 fast and 20 AC chargers; it breaks below about ten sessions a day per fast charger, or if the service-fee cap is cut [Kira estimates]
5 · Go / no-go at the end of the pilot
Go if hub chargers average 6+ sessions a day by month 9 and are on track for 10, fleets supply 30%+ of kWh and uptime is 97%+; no-go below 4 a day at month 12 [Kira estimates]
